## Intake Decision

No commit in this tail supplies the missing external scientific MCP,
automation authority, browser-control, or annotation architecture. The pair
command is valuable future remote-access UX but is privileged user-only
credential/network administration, not agent authority. Ghostty remains a
separate terminal-platform program requiring visual, accessibility,
performance, CSP, and supply-chain proof. Mobile snooze is retained only as a
future lifecycle concept; its code, the settled shelf, geometry patch, and
inferior inline search are rejected. No code, workflow, mobile surface,
credential model, release authority, or donor ancestry is selected.
